text: Kraken Parent Payward Partners with Singapore Gulf Bank to Offer 24/7 Settlement for Institutional Digital Asset Markets Kraken parent company Payward and Singapore Gulf Bank (SGB), a fully licensed digital bank regulated by the Central Bank of Bahrain, have announced a strategic partnership. Payward has integrated SGB's real-time, multi-currency clearing network, SGB Net, to provide institutional clients in specific jurisdictions across Asia and the Gulf region with 24/7 instant settlement. text: Binance to Block Brazil Cross-Border Crypto Transfers From Nov. 1 Without Purpose and Counterparty Details Binance will require Brazilian users to disclose the purpose and counterparty of cross-border crypto transfers from Nov. 1, CryptoSlate reported. Withdrawals cannot be submitted until the questionnaire is completed. Deposits may stay pending and, in some cases, be returned if the information is missing. Transfers between Brazilian residents are unaffected. Binance will report the transactions monthly to Brazil's central bank under Resolution BCB No. 521/2025. Transfers of up to $50,000 use a 10-purpose list; larger ones require one of 96 classifications. Some transfers are capped at $100,000 if the counterparty is not authorized in Brazil's FX market. — link

text: Onchain has had a considerable vibe shift the past fews days. Multiple 8 fig runners over 24 hours during a weekend while everything looked dead in the water. Leading coins like AI, Pons, Stonk, Cashcat, Marscoin etc all slow bleeding/ranging. When looking for signs of momentum to shift, this is always my #1 variable. Shows peak boredom and traders will to punt on novel ideas. Very noteworthy that majority of the runners have been utility projects, think we're getting to exhaustion on the stock coins and crypto pairings. I still think RH will dominate but like Cashcats initial run, it needs a cool off while they continuing building out liquidity flywheels. Some of the runners: $POD (73 mil) - AI inference play and connected to VVV eco. Pumped hard off a Upbit listing and helped set a trend with smaller onchain coins. $IMD (40 mil ath) - AI agent launchpad where each of 2,000 identity md NFTs is a seat in the swarm. A holder registers it as an ERC 8004 agent, runs it and takes jobs. Dev is a bit schizo on both ends of the spectrum, still better than having a silent team. $ZIPCOIN (40 mil ath) - Essentially designed from Vitaliks Snowmoon article. It's a private money payment layer where Zip deposits ZC or ETH into a privacy pool as a note. Unzip withdraws to a fresh address with a zero knowledge proof, so nothing onchain links it to the source wallet. Speak burns coins with a message. Knock burns at someone's ENS name, so the message waits at their door. $HOOKR (28 mil ath) - V4 Uniswap hooks on RH. Protocol takes a share of the add on rules and uses it to buy back and burn HOOKR. $AGENCY (24 mil ath) - AI agent launchpad where anyone can mint a coin with its own LLM mind. Creator fees locked into the coins own treasury and used for buyback and burns. Main narrative is that this is a more completed ai16z. All the rails for agents to do useful tasks and have independence are mostly available. Current bottlenecks I can see is agents cannot send funds to arbitrary wallets, accept outside messages or autonomously add liquidity. If the team can implement more experimental features, it does have a chance at becoming a fully encompassing agent platform. $HOOKED (16 mil ath) - Basically the same as Hookr but on Solana. Every trade on a Hooked curve pays a 1% fee. 85% buys HOOKED on the market and burns it, 15% funds development. $PRIORS (13 mil ATH) - Onchain credit pool on RH for ERC 8004 agents. Agents borrow USDG, but only after a person, sponsor, or the treasury puts money behind them. If the agent does not repay, that backer's stake is lost first, before lenders. Pretty cool narrative being on RH. $SURPLUS (13 mil ath) - AI inference play and fundamentally one of the better coins and RR's out of everything that's available. Stats are strong with a dedicated team. Was stuck in a range due to uncertainty around the tokens involvement but looks like there's more progress on how they can include it. Worth dd'ing imo. Nice to see AI/private inference coins back in the limelight. Think we're long overdue for some good utility coins as it's been predominately memes since Ansem launched. Best use of time is creating forward looking theses for where there's limitations/bottlenecks in current projects and keeping an eye out for teams trying to solve them. Normally this can be a double edge sword but feels like the perfect time to be doing homework. There's quite a few inefficiencies and gaps that hungry teams can fill.
